description: Extends the frozen v1 two-state sweep along the run-length axis at the measured dialogue/narration contrast, to locate the run length at which a two-mode process reproduces the observed f3 rho, and to test whether any single run length reproduces the observed phi(n) shape. Reuses the v1 fitted parameter artifact unchanged; no refit, no new segmentation, no generated text.

parameter_artifact.rule: identical to v1; the runner must refuse to run if the hash differs

pre_registration.freeze_instruction: Review, set status to frozen_before_simulation, record this file's sha256 in the manifest and commit before the inferential run. The exploratory run of 17 Sep 2026 (claude/extended-dwell-sweep-2026-09-17.md) informed these predictions and is superseded by this run.
pre_registration.claim: Level versus shape: a two-mode contrast of dialogue size persisting for a few hundred marks can reproduce the observed level of f3 overdispersion; no single run length reproduces its growth across chunk sizes.

P1_cap.statement: The pure-mode cap on excess divergence, computed analytically from the fitted parameters (mode share-weighted sum over rows of pi_s(i) KL(T_s(i,.) || T_pool(i,.))), exceeds the observed delta of 0.028 nats in every fold.

P2_level.statement: The fixed-intercept rho of the simulated two-state process at contrast 1.0 crosses the observed 0.000629 at a mean run length between 150 and 400 marks (dwell multiplier between 20 and 52).
P2_level.decision: holds if the seed-averaged rho curve, linearly interpolated in dwell_scale, crosses 0.000629 within [20, 52]; the crossing multiplier and its seed range are the reported scale estimate
P2_level.exploratory_value: crossing near multiplier 32 (mean run ~244 marks; rho 0.00065)

P3_shape.statement: At the crossing multiplier, the simulated phi(n) curve is flatter than observed: phi(1000) exceeds the observed 1.51 and phi(4000) falls short of the observed 3.56, and the growth ratio phi(4000)/phi(2000) is below the observed 1.59.
P3_shape.decision: holds if, at the crossing cell, simulated phi(1000) > 1.51, simulated phi(4000) < 3.56, and growth ratio < 1.59 with all three seed-level values on the same side
P3_shape.reading_if_holds: variation at more than one scale (scene plus a slower book-scale component), consistent with the same-book/different-book divergence split
P3_shape.reading_if_fails: a single scene-scale two-mode process is sufficient for both level and shape; the book-scale component is not needed

P4_no_single_match.statement: No dwell multiplier in the grid places all three simulated phi(n) inside the observed author-bootstrap intervals simultaneously.
P4_no_single_match.decision: holds if for every multiplier at least one of the three seed-averaged phi values lies outside its observed interval

unexcluded_alternatives: a distribution of run lengths (mixture of scales) rather than a single multiplier
a slowly varying outer state at book scale
reference-profile estimation error interacting with long runs
genre, chapter structure, editorial house style

simulation.sampling_frame: identical to v1: each simulated observation samples one entry uniformly from the pooled human book-by-chunk frame at that chunk size, generates through the selected chunk position, and scores that chunk against a two-synthetic-book estimated reference
simulation.folds: the five v1 author folds with the v1 fitted parameters; every cell is run in every fold and pooled exactly as v1 pools

estimands.phi_n: pooled-chunk mean G divided by 90, per (dwell_scale, seed, chunk_size); seed-averaged with seed range
estimands.fixed_intercept_rho: least-squares slope of phi(n)-1 on n with intercept fixed at one, per (dwell_scale, seed); seed-averaged
estimands.crossing_multiplier: dwell_scale at which the seed-averaged rho equals the observed 0.000629, by linear interpolation between adjacent grid points; reported with the range across seeds
estimands.crossing_run_length: crossing_multiplier times the v1 fitted mean dwell length pooled over both states (7.58 marks, fold range 7.32-7.87)
estimands.phi_at_crossing: the 'crossing cell' of P3 is the seed-averaged crossing_multiplier, which generally falls between grid points: phi(n) there is linearly interpolated in dwell_scale between the adjacent grid points, exactly as rho is, for the seed-averaged curve and for each seed's curve evaluated at that same multiplier (the three 'seed-level values'); the growth ratio is formed from the interpolated phi
estimands.growth_ratio: phi(4000)/phi(2000) per (dwell_scale, seed); seed-averaged rows use the seed-averaged phi
estimands.phi_rmse: root mean squared difference between simulated and observed phi over the three chunk sizes, per (dwell_scale, seed)
estimands.cap: per fold, sum over states of (state mark share) times sum over rows of pi_s(i) KL(T_s(i,.) || T_pool(i,.)), for f3; and share-weighted KL(pi_s || pi_pool) for f1; computed from the frozen parameter artifact, no simulation

outputs.extended_sweep_observations.csv: one row per simulated chunk: dwell_scale, seed, fold, author, target_book, chunk_size, chunk_index, G, excess_delta
outputs.extended_sweep_summary.csv: one row per (dwell_scale, seed, chunk_size): n_observations, mean_G, phi, phi_ci_low, phi_ci_high (chunk-level percentile bootstrap, 2000 draws)
outputs.extended_sweep_rho.csv: one row per (dwell_scale, seed): fixed_intercept_rho, growth_ratio, phi_rmse; plus seed-averaged rows
outputs.extended_sweep_crossing.csv: crossing_multiplier and crossing_run_length per seed and seed-averaged
outputs.cap.csv: per fold and mean: cap_f1, cap_f3, ratio to observed delta
outputs.predictions_check.json: verdict on P1-P4 with the numbers that decided each
outputs.manifest.json: config sha256, parent config sha256, parameter artifact sha256, cache sha256, seeds, environment packages, git commit and dirty flag, output sha256 for every file above

figures.extended_phi_curves.pdf: phi(n) for each dwell_scale (seed-averaged, seed range as band) with the observed curve and its intervals
figures.extended_rho_vs_dwell.pdf: seed-averaged rho against mean run length in marks, observed rho as a horizontal line, crossing marked
figures.figure_manifest.json: as in reference_design: results-manifest sha256, plotter sha256, figure sha256s

required: runner refuses to start if parameter_artifact sha256 differs from the frozen artifact
runner refuses to start unless pre_registration.status == frozen_before_simulation, unless an explicit --engineering-smoke flag is given, in which case the manifest records engineering_smoke=true
at dwell_scale 1.0 (add temporarily in a smoke run) phi reproduces the v1 fitted point 0.756/0.880/1.016 within simulation noise
crossing interpolation returns the exact grid point when rho equals the target there, and None when the curve never crosses
cap computation on a synthetic two-state parameter set with identical modes returns 0, and with disjoint modes returns the analytic value
every output listed in the config is written and hashed into the manifest

verifier: add verify_process_simulation_v2_extended to tools/verify_reproducibility.py mirroring verify_reference_design: config hash, parent config hash, parameter artifact hash, cache hash, output hashes, figure manifest linkage, plotter hash, PDF hashes, paper inclusion of extended_rho_vs_dwell

paper.replaces: the exploratory paragraph and its placeholder in the subsection 'Where the heterogeneity must live' (sec:simulation)
paper.adds: one table (dwell multiplier, mean run length, phi(1000/2000/4000), rho, growth ratio) at the grid points around the crossing, and the crossing estimate with its seed range as a number of record
paper.analysis_plan_note: one clause in the Analysis plan acknowledging this as a test pre-specified outside the declared grid, alongside the reference-design test
